description: TieringOffloadingSpec with no secondary tiers, whose manager forwards to its CPU primary tier: reset_cache while a store is in flight, then the request registered again, as the tiering manager requires (it drops every request's state on reset, vllm/v1/kv_offload/tiering/manager.py:935-980@5df63a72): the cache starts empty at slot 0. The scheduler never completes a pre-reset job (reset_cache's own comment), so this sequence does not either.
